lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid-like formation along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a structured matrix of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (bright superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) running longitudinally along the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, lower-intensity high-luminance blobs scattered across the surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of smaller diameter high-luminance spots on the cranial region and the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
